name: study-skills
title_zh: 读完的书会自己长成一张可检索的笔记网
tagline_zh: 不靠意志力复习，靠分析阅读+双向链接卡片+可证伪信念，让知识在下次用之前就自动串好。附赠一个本地 CLI。
tagline_en: No willpower reviews. Analytical reading + bidirectional cards + falsifiable beliefs wire knowledge together.
desc_en: A Claude Code plugin for durable agent learning: analytical reading, a cross-linked Zettelkasten slip-box with a bundled CLI, first-person beliefs with falsifiers, experience capture, and deliberation forks.
why_zh: 它把「记住」改成「长出来」：每张卡片必须带出处和反例，信念必须写清什么能推翻它——知识不是收藏。
why_en: It turns memorizing into growing: every card needs a source and a counterexample; beliefs must state what falsifies them.
limit_zh: 只覆盖个人学习流程，不接团队知识库；需要你已有 Zettelkasten 习惯或愿意从零搭；CLI 只做检索和链接。
limit_en: Personal learning only, no team KB. Requires existing Zettelkasten habit or willingness to start from scratch. CLI searches/links only—no.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Books you read grow into a searchable note web
